capabilities: Read notes, PDFs, HTML and web pages aloud
Highlight the current passage during playback
Navigate and read by heading outline
Configure local and online TTS voices
extras: Desktop only; formerly named Note and PDF Voice Reader. Online voices send text to third-party services and may incur fees, while system speech and local CosyVoice keep text local. Some advanced help and secondary dialogs remain English-only.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in text-to-speech, so listening to notes, PDFs or web pages requires a separate external tool.

relations.evidence: install and enable HTML Reader from Settings -> Community plugins -> Browse
Install and enable the Copilot community plugin in Obsidian to create and save conversations.
separately install and enable the optional Editing Toolbar community plugin
when a recognized floating-outline plugin is enabled, including Floating TOC

requires.name: Online speech provider API key (MiMo, OpenRouter, Azure, BYOK)
Online TTS provider (usage fees may apply)

summary: Read-aloud plugin that speaks notes, PDFs, HTML and web pages with local or online voices, highlighting text and exporting audio.
